contract.title: Exact-commit adversarial review of ISL pressure R03
contract.goal: Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES after checking the one-second directed-ISL rebinner, matched queue-wait reconstruction, compact persisted diagnostics, four-way decision tree, two-cell config identity and claim boundaries. Focus on counterexamples that could misclassify denominator collapse, physical unavailability, control-plane failure, access failure, NO_ROUTE, queue overflow or incomplete drain as congestion. Do not edit files and do not propose a large matrix or RL training.
acceptance: Every finding names exact repository files and executable counterexamples or tests.
Verify exact commit and that the two resolved configs differ only in links.rf_isl.bandwidth_hz.
Check whether the decision thresholds are mechanically decidable from persisted V2 analysis fields.
State open_items explicitly and give PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES.
requiredEvidence: Exact file paths and line-grounded evidence
At least one adversarial synthetic-ledger counterexample or a statement that existing tests cover it
Explicit separation of code correctness, experiment validity and claim limits
